This app\'s code evolved step by step through an ongoing conversation between its developer Salman and Claude from Anthropic: the idea and decisions are Salman\'s, the writing and refining happened between them.
FreeLLM Chat brings free AI providers into one conversation and spreads your messages across them automatically.
When a model\'s free quota ends or it fails, the app moves to the next one instantly and continues your answer where it stopped.

FreeLLM Chat is one conversation that brings together dozens of free AI models. When one runs out of quota the app moves to the next so your answer continues uninterrupted. It is made for people without a budget or without access to these services in their country.

What is stored, what is sent and how you stay in control.
Your privacy is the foundation of this app. This page explains clearly what happens to your data.

FreeLLM Chat has no server and no user accounts, uses no analytics or ad tools, and we collect no data about you. Everything you do stays on your device, except what you send to the AI providers you choose.
What is stored on your device

Chats and attachments in a local database, settings, the failure log and quota usage, and the local brain memory if you turn it on. API keys are stored encrypted with AES-256 through the Android keystore and are excluded from Android\'s cloud backup.
What is sent over the internet

When you send a message, its text, your attachments, the needed conversation context and your key go directly to the provider that answers (such as Groq or Gemini) over encrypted HTTPS, and are subject to that provider\'s privacy policy. The app also downloads the updated model list from the catalog link without sending personal data. Unencrypted http is allowed only for local addresses inside your network.

Some free providers may use chats to improve or train their models. Do not type passwords or sensitive financial or health information. You can turn on the option to avoid providers that train on my data so the app excludes models whose chats may be used to improve products.
If you enter a proxy link (Cloudflare Worker) in settings, requests and your keys pass through that proxy. Use a proxy you own or trust. If the field is empty there is no proxy.

App lock with your device fingerprint or code is optional, screenshots are blocked on key and backup screens, and a copied key is cleared from the clipboard after 30 seconds. Backups are encrypted with a password you set and saved to a folder you choose.
At any time you can delete all chats, clear the local brain memory or delete any provider key. Uninstalling the app removes all of its data from your device.
This policy may be updated as the app evolves, and the last update date appears at the bottom of the page. Continuing to use the app means you accept it.
